description.text: The major is designed to train professionals with the basic knowledge of modern management, and computer science and technology, who are capable of information systemic analysis and design and information management as well. Graduates are qualified in such position as analysis, design, implementation, operation and maintenance of information system, and information management at all levels of management section, businesses (especially the communications business), financial institutions, and scientific research units. As an important strategic resource in modern society, information is the basis of development of a knowledge-based economy. It is a combination of the theory, management, technology, methods, economics, and policy of information resources. Combined the characteristics of IT and professional, it has become increasingly important and popular with today's enterprise resource planning (ERP), supply chain management (SCM), customer relationship management (CRM), IT project management, as well as the development of e-commerce. It puts special emphasis on the professional training of management theories, methods, means, information systems application software design and programming, computer software, systems integration and other information processing technology in modern information systems, including government and economic information management with the information integration and development of information systems at the core. It emphasizes the comprehensive ability in information and communication technologies, especially the multimedia technology, network technology, database technology, information services of analysis, design, implementation, maintenance, management and evaluation for practical software. Students in the first two years are trained in accordance with the largest category of information management for a theoretical foundation. At the third school year they finish the follow-up professional courses in accordance with their own choice of specialties.

duration.text: The Information Management and Information System at Chongqing University of Posts and Telecommunications is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 2083 USD/per year ￥ 15000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1.Certificate of HSK Certificate of HSK (Chinese Proficiency Test) 2.Photocopy of valid passport With name, passport number & expiration date, and photo included 3.Passport photo A recent passport-sized photo of the applicant 4.High school academic transcript 5.High school graduate certificate Graduation certificate in languages other than Chinese or English should be translated into Chinese or English and be certified by notarization.

requirements.text: With senior high school diploma and HSK certificate of level 4 or above
